TABLE.NAME: agon
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the agon activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: gamecrossword
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the crossword game is enabled.

FIELD.NAME: gamequestion
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the weekly question game is enabled.

FIELD.NAME: gamecoding
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the coding game is enabled.

FIELD.NAME: contentcrossword
FIELD.COMMENT: Crossword JSON content.

FIELD.NAME: contentquestion
FIELD.COMMENT: Question JSON content.

FIELD.NAME: contentcoding
FIELD.COMMENT: Coding JSON content.

TABLE.NAME: agon_attempt
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per student's run of an agon activity instance.

FIELD.NAME: agonid
FIELD.COMMENT: The agon instance this attempt belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student who made the attempt.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: Attempt state: inprogress or finished.

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt was started (server clock).

FIELD.NAME: timefinish
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt was finished; 0 while in progress.

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Total score across all games.

FIELD.NAME: scorecrossword
FIELD.COMMENT: Crossword game score.

FIELD.NAME: scorequestion
FIELD.COMMENT: Weekly question game score.

FIELD.NAME: scorecoding
FIELD.COMMENT: Coding game score.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt row was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: submittedgames
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of game keys already submitted (one submission per game).

FIELD.NAME: hintsused
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of game keys whose one hint has been used.

KEY.NAME: agonid-userid
KEY.COMMENT: One attempt per student per instance.
